title: Liquidity model: completed-candle volume only
reason: Pre-evaluation review found that the participation cap used the volume of the executing candle, which is unknown at its open (future information in an execution decision). Verified with a synthetic test (same history, different executing-candle volume -> 500.00 vs 10.02 USDT filled).
owner_approval: Owner message 2026-11-25: liquidity-model correction approved; median volume of the previous 24 fully completed hourly candles, max_participation 10 %, never the execution candle's volume; shared budget per asset per candle; fail-closed rules; versioned amendment; one research CI run authorised if all checks pass.

changes.summary: liquidity budget now uses the median volume of the 24 completed candles before the executing candle, shared across all orders of an asset; fail-closed on missing/invalid volume and short history; Result.exposure added (not hashed)
time-based mutation of prices/volumes and restart helpers for real-data causality checks (additive)
adds liquidity_model text, benchmark_disclosure and evaluation_protocol; every parameter, threshold and date unchanged

unchanged_parameters: FamilyAConfig, breaker thresholds, costs, max_participation 0.10, T1-T10, statistical rules, evaluation dates, holdout
